serverPath.title: Server Path
serverPath.description: Absolute path to a `texlab` executable. Leave empty to use the copy the editor installed, or the one on PATH.

notifyWhenMissing.title: Notify When Missing
notifyWhenMissing.description: Show a notification when the language server cannot be found, offering to install it. Turned off by the notification’s Never Ask Again button.

features.title: Features
features.description: Which parts of Texlab the editor uses. Turning one off hands it to the next server serving the same file. Only what Texlab implements is listed: it has no signature help, code actions, code lens or semantic tokens.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Report the build log and ChkTeX findings in the linter.

autocomplete.title: Autocomplete
autocomplete.description: Offer commands, environments, citations and labels while typing.

hover.title: Hover
hover.description: Show package documentation, citations and label targets on hover.

definition.title: Go To Definition
definition.description: Jump from a citation or reference to what it points at.

references.title: Find References
references.description: List the uses of a label, citation key or command.

symbols.title: Symbols
symbols.description: Serve document and project symbols to go-to-symbol.

outline.title: Outline
outline.description: Fill the outline panel with the document's sections and environments.

format.title: Format
format.description: Format documents with the formatter chosen below.

rename.title: Rename
rename.description: Rename a label or citation key across the project.

inlayHints.title: Inlay Hints
inlayHints.description: Show what a label points at, inline beside it.

build.title: Build
build.description: Texlab can compile the document itself. It is off by default because the `latex-tools` package already does, and both on means every save compiles twice.

onSave.title: Build On Save
onSave.description: Compile the document every time it is saved.

args.title: Build Arguments
args.description: Arguments passed to the build program. `%f` is the file being compiled, and the placeholders `%d`, `%e` and `%b` are its directory, extension and base name.

forwardSearchAfter.title: Forward Search After Build
forwardSearchAfter.description: Jump the viewer to the cursor once a build finishes.

auxDirectory.title: Auxiliary Directory
auxDirectory.description: Where the build writes its auxiliary files, relative to the root document.

logDirectory.title: Log Directory
logDirectory.description: Where the build writes its log, relative to the root document.

pdfDirectory.title: PDF Directory
pdfDirectory.description: Where the build writes its PDF, relative to the root document.

filename.title: Output Filename
filename.description: Name of the built PDF. Leave empty to take it from the root document.

forwardSearch.title: Forward Search
forwardSearch.description: The PDF viewer Texlab tells to jump to the cursor's position. Leave the executable empty to use the `latex-tools` viewer instead.

args.title: Viewer Arguments
args.description: Arguments passed to the viewer. `%f` is the root document, `%p` the built PDF, and `%l` the current line.

chktex.title: ChkTeX
chktex.description: Texlab can run ChkTeX for style and consistency warnings on top of the build log. The `chktex` binary comes with TeX Live and MiKTeX.

onOpenAndSave.title: Run On Open And Save
onOpenAndSave.description: Run ChkTeX when a document is opened and when it is saved.

onEdit.title: Run On Edit
onEdit.description: Run ChkTeX as you type, rather than only on open and save.

additionalArgs.title: Additional Arguments
additionalArgs.description: Extra arguments passed to `chktex`, such as `-n` to silence a warning.

latexFormatter.title: LaTeX Formatter
latexFormatter.description: Which formatter formats `.tex` documents. `latexindent` and `tex-fmt` are separate programs that must be on your PATH.

formatterLineLength.title: Formatter Line Length
formatterLineLength.description: Column the formatter wraps at. Set to 0 to leave lines unwrapped.

latexindent.title: latexindent
latexindent.description: Options passed to `latexindent` when it is the chosen formatter.

local.title: Local Settings File
local.description: A `latexindent` YAML file to load in addition to the defaults, relative to the file being formatted.

modifyLineBreaks.title: Modify Line Breaks
modifyLineBreaks.description: Let latexindent add and remove line breaks, not just indentation.

replacement.title: Replacement Flag
replacement.description: The replacement mode flag to pass, one of `-r`, `-rv` or `-rr`. Leave empty for none.

diagnosticsDelay.title: Diagnostics Delay
diagnosticsDelay.description: Milliseconds of quiet before diagnostics are recomputed.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Which of Texlab's messages reach the linter — its own syntax errors as well as the build log and ChkTeX. The patterns are regular expressions matched against the message text; an allow list, when it is not empty, is applied first. A change takes effect the next time the document is analyzed.

allowedPatterns.title: Allowed Patterns
allowedPatterns.description: Report only the messages matching one of these.

ignoredPatterns.title: Ignored Patterns
ignoredPatterns.description: Never report a message matching one of these.

symbols.title: Symbols
symbols.description: Which symbols reach the outline and go-to-symbol. The patterns are regular expressions matched against the symbol name.

allowedPatterns.title: Allowed Patterns
allowedPatterns.description: Serve only the symbols matching one of these.

ignoredPatterns.title: Ignored Patterns
ignoredPatterns.description: Never serve a symbol matching one of these.

inlayHints.title: Inlay Hints
inlayHints.description: The labels Texlab renders inline. The editor's own Inlay Hints setting has to be on as well.

labelDefinitions.title: Label Definitions
labelDefinitions.description: Show what a \label names, beside its definition.

labelReferences.title: Label References
labelReferences.description: Show what a \ref resolves to, beside the reference.

maxLength.title: Maximum Length
maxLength.description: Longer hints are truncated. Set to 0 for no limit.

matcher.title: Matcher
matcher.description: How what you have typed is matched against the candidates. Fuzzy matching finds a candidate from any subsequence of its letters; prefix matching only from its start.

hover.title: Hover
hover.description: What a hover shows for a mathematical symbol.

symbols.title: Symbol Rendering
symbols.description: How a symbol command is shown on hover.

experimental.title: Experimental
experimental.description: Commands and environments Texlab does not know, so that it treats yours the way it treats the standard ones. Each list adds to the built-in set rather than replacing it.

followPackageLinks.title: Follow Package Links
followPackageLinks.description: Analyze the .sty and .cls files the document loads, not just the document itself.

mathEnvironments.title: Math Environments
mathEnvironments.description: Environment names to treat as mathematics.

enumEnvironments.title: Enumeration Environments
enumEnvironments.description: Environment names to treat as enumerations.

verbatimEnvironments.title: Verbatim Environments
verbatimEnvironments.description: Environment names whose contents are not LaTeX and must not be analyzed.

citationCommands.title: Citation Commands
citationCommands.description: Command names that cite a BibTeX entry.

glossaryReferenceCommands.title: Glossary Reference Commands
glossaryReferenceCommands.description: Command names that reference a glossary entry.

labelDefinitionCommands.title: Label Definition Commands
labelDefinitionCommands.description: Command names that define a label.

labelReferenceCommands.title: Label Reference Commands
labelReferenceCommands.description: Command names that reference a label.

labelReferenceRangeCommands.title: Label Reference Range Commands
labelReferenceRangeCommands.description: Command names that reference a range of labels, taking a start and an end.
